summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; one test added each in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only.
